kind: exact pin of the audited geometry dependency closure; combined candidate browser/installed/normal

finding.external: d3-array 3.2.5 was published 2026-11-03 by its maintainers through trusted publishing with SLSA provenance. It ships dist/ only (no src/).
finding.impact: d3-geo declares d3-array '2.5.0 - 3', so new installs of ggaction resolved the unaudited 3.2.5. The installed browser import map (node_modules/d3-array/src/index.js) returned 404 and every installed browser page failed to load; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES and the source-signature manifest describe 3.2.4.

decision: Declare the whole manifest closure as exact direct dependencies (d3-array 3.2.4, internmap 2.0.3, geographic-math npm:d3-geo@3.1.1). npm does not apply overrides for consumers, so only direct exact dependencies pin installed applications. Covered by remainingApproval; the native policy of no external chart engine and one audited geometry closure is kept and tightened.
contracts: native-api-policy: dependency keys equal the closure
geographic-math: every transitive manifest package pinned exactly in package.json and lock root; dependency keys equal manifest install keys
lockEdit: Only the root dependency entry was edited; npm 10.9.8 --package-lock-only also removed unrelated libc fields, which was reverted.
residualRisk: If an application already hoists a different d3-array at its top level, npm nests the pinned copy under ggaction and the browser import map path may resolve the application's copy; Node resolution is unaffected.
